bio: Bob Smith has spent more than 26 years as a marching instructor, visual caption head, consultant and drill designer for drum corps and marching bands around the country. He aged out of Phantom Regiment in 1985 and went on to serve as a marching instructor or Visual Caption Head for Phantom Regiment (1987-1997, 2000-2004), including the corps' 1996 DCI World Championship season. He has also worked with Tar Heel Sound, the Colts (2006-2009), and Spirit of Atlanta. Outside of drum corps he teaches mathematics at Leyden High School near Chicago and was inducted into the Illinois Tennis Coaches Hall of Fame in 2011.

Bryan Nungaray is a percussion educator and performer active in the marching arts. He has worked with the Mandarins Drum & Bugle Corps of Sacramento, California, as well as the Academy Drum & Bugle Corps of Tempe, Arizona, and Ayala High School in Chino Hills, California. He is an endorsing artist for Innovative Percussion, Pearl Drums, Zildjian, and Remo.

Danny Brock is a brass instructor in the marching arts who has taught at multiple Drum Corps International ensembles, including the Santa Clara Vanguard, Phantom Regiment, and Blue Knights. A native of the Dallas-Fort Worth area, he marched as horn sergeant with the Bluecoats Drum and Bugle Corps from 2010 to 2012, earning a bronze medal. He earned a Bachelor of Music in music education from Stephen F. Austin State University and a Master's degree in trumpet performance from the University of North Texas, where he has pursued a Doctorate of Musical Arts.
